nameEn: Manufacture of cocoa, chocolate and sugar confectionery
description: This class includes the manufacture of cocoa, chocolate and sugar confectionery products.
includes: manufacture of cocoa, cocoa butter, cocoa fat and oil
manufacture of chocolate and chocolate confectionery
manufacture of sugar confectionery: caramels, cachous, nougats, fondant, white chocolate
manufacture of preserves of fruit, nuts or other parts of plants by sugar
excludes: manufacture of ice cream and other edible ice, see 1050
